who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), command/unitkey lane, round two
what: core's surface task was refused OutsideSourceRoot because the gather skipped `#[path = "io_slice/repr_iovec.rs"] mod repr;` inside a `cfg_select!` call; a first fix evaluated cfg_select!/cfg_if! by name and was replaced in the same round by a name-agnostic token rule
cost: one round of a lane writing a cfg evaluator for two macro names, then deleting it
cause: the image only made mod rows for parsed `mod` items; `cfg_select` was in QUIET as if it wrote no items
whys: macro calls were treated as opaque to the gather
the key comes before expansion, so no expansion can say which files a call names
the first fix matched macros by name, which libc's own cfg_if! and compiler_builtins' cfg_select_nofmt! would have needed one by one
class: an input set derived from a parse that skips macro token trees
prevention: every item-level macro call's tokens are scanned for `mod` declarations, all candidate files over-approximated; the std test asserts the census list of such files
state: fixed in the tree, not compiled
